description_en: Performs a paging query of desktop applications visible to the current tenant, with support for filtering by application name and source
description_zh: 分页查询当前租户可见的桌面应用，支持按应用名称和来源筛选
name: ListTenantApp

parameters.help_en: The application name keyword, matched by containment. If this parameter is not specified or is set to an empty string, no name-based filtering is applied. `%` can be used as a wildcard, and `_` is matched as a literal character
parameters.help_zh: 应用名称关键词，按包含关系匹配。未传或传空串时不按名称筛选；`%` 可作为通配符，`_` 按普通字符匹配
parameters.name: key_name

parameters.help_en:
The application source. Valid values:
MARKET: marketplace applications.
TENANT: applications uploaded by the current tenant.

If this parameter is not specified, both types of visible applications are queried
parameters.help_zh: 应用来源：MARKET 表示市场应用，TENANT 表示当前租户上传的应用。省略时查询两类可见应用
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. If this parameter is not specified or is set to a value less than or equal to 0, the value 1 is used
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始。未传或小于等于 0 时使用 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 500. If this parameter is not specified, is set to a value less than or equal to 0, or is set to a value greater than 500, the value 20 is used
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，有效范围 1～500。未传、小于等于 0 或大于 500 时使用 20
parameters.name: page_size

Code.description_en: The business result code, returned as a string. The value is typically "200" when the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 业务结果码，类型为字符串；成功时通常为 "200"

Data.description_en: The list of applications on the current page. Each element represents an application
Data.description_zh: 当前页应用列表，每个元素表示一个应用

AdminTag.description_en: An internal field. We do not recommend that you use this field

items.description_en: An internal field. We do not recommend that you use this field

AppAdminTag.description_en: An internal field. We do not recommend that you use this field

AppRegInfo.description_en: The application registry identification information, returned as a string. This value can be used to match the name of an application registry entry
AppRegInfo.description_zh: 应用注册表识别信息，以字符串形式返回，可用于匹配应用注册表条目的名称

AppTag.description_en: An internal field. We do not recommend that you use this field

items.description_en: An internal field. We do not recommend that you use this field

AppUid.description_en: The application UID string, which is a different identifier from the numeric Id field
AppUid.description_zh: 应用 UID 字符串，与数值类型 Id 是不同标识

AuthType.description_en:
The authorization dimension of the application.

Valid values:
auth_type_user: Authorized by user.
auth_type_resource_group: Authorized by resource group
AuthType.description_zh:
应用授权维度，

取值说明：auth_type_user：按用户授权；auth_type_resource_group：按资源组授权

AutoInstallmentType.description_en:
The new automatic installation scope policy. Use this field together with AuthType to determine the authorization dimension. Valid values:
0: Automatically install for all visible users or resource groups.
1: Automatically install for some visible users or resource groups.
2: Disable automatic installation.
99: Unknown policy.

This field describes the configuration scope and does not indicate that the installation has been completed on the endpoint
AutoInstallmentType.description_zh: 新版自动安装范围策略，结合 AuthType 判断授权维度。取值：0 表示为全部可见用户或资源组自动安装；1 表示为部分可见用户或资源组自动安装；2 表示关闭自动安装；99 表示未知策略。该字段描述配置范围，不代表终端已完成安装

CateId.description_en: The display category ID of the application. The category ID is a dynamic identifier and is not a fixed enumeration
CateId.description_zh: 应用展示类目 ID。类目 ID 为动态标识，不是固定枚举

CateName.description_en: The display category name of the application

Developer.description_en: The name of the application developer

DistributeType.description_en:
The authorization distribution scope of the application. This field must be interpreted together with AuthType. An empty value does not necessarily mean that the application is not distributed.

Valid values:
ALL: Distributed to all.
DESIGNATED: Distributed to a specified scope.
NOTDISTRO: Not distributed.
UNKNOWN: Unknown scope.

The distribution target is determined by AuthType
DistributeType.description_zh:
应用授权分配范围，枚举见下文；必须结合 AuthType 解读。为空不能直接解释为不分配。

取值说明：ALL：全部分配；DESIGNATED：指定范围分配；NOTDISTRO：不分配；UNKNOWN：未知范围。分配对象由 AuthType 决定

ExpireTime.description_en: The authorization end time of the application. The value is returned as a string with a time zone, in the format of date, the letter T, hours-minutes-seconds, 3-digit milliseconds, and a time zone offset without colons. The +0000 in the example indicates UTC. This field may be empty or not returned if no value is available
ExpireTime.description_zh: 应用授权结束时间。以带时区的字符串返回，依次包含日期、字母 T、时分秒、3 位毫秒及不带冒号的时区偏移；示例中的 +0000 表示 UTC。无值时可能为空或不返回

Extend.description_en: The extended information of the application, returned as a string. There is no unified fixed field structure
Extend.description_zh: 应用扩展信息，以字符串形式返回；没有统一固定字段结构

FileName.description_en: The storage file name of the installation package, which may differ from the original file name
FileName.description_zh: 安装包的存储文件名，可能与原始文件名不同

FilePath.description_en: The storage path of the installation package. This value is not a directly accessible download URL
FilePath.description_zh: 安装包存储路径；该值不等于可直接访问的下载 URL

FileRealName.description_en: The original file name of the installation package

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the application record. The value is returned as a string with a time zone, in the format of date, the letter T, hours-minutes-seconds, 3-digit milliseconds, and a time zone offset without colons. The +0000 in the example indicates UTC. This field may be empty or not returned if no value is available
GmtCreate.description_zh: 应用记录创建时间。以带时区的字符串返回，依次包含日期、字母 T、时分秒、3 位毫秒及不带冒号的时区偏移；示例中的 +0000 表示 UTC。无值时可能为空或不返回

GmtModified.description_en: The last modification time of the application record. The value is returned as a string with a time zone, in the format of date, the letter T, hours-minutes-seconds, 3-digit milliseconds, and a time zone offset without colons. The +0000 in the example indicates UTC. This field may be empty or not returned if no value is available
GmtModified.description_zh: 应用记录最近修改时间。以带时区的字符串返回，依次包含日期、字母 T、时分秒、3 位毫秒及不带冒号的时区偏移；示例中的 +0000 表示 UTC。无值时可能为空或不返回

IconUrl.description_en: The icon URL of the application

IconUrlInternal.description_en: The internal network icon URL of the application. Use this URL only when the corresponding network access conditions are met. The domain name in the example is for illustrative purposes only
IconUrlInternal.description_zh: 应用内网图标 URL，仅在具备相应网络访问条件时使用。示例域名仅用于说明 URL 格式

Id.description_en: The numeric ID of the application, used as the identity of the application and to associate what to do next
Id.description_zh: 应用数值 ID，用于标识应用及关联后续操作

IsAdmin.description_en:
Specifies whether elevated privilege installation is configured. This does not indicate the administrator identity of the caller.

Valid values:
true: Elevated privilege installation is configured.
false: Elevated privilege installation is not configured
IsAdmin.description_zh:
是否配置提权安装：true 是，false 否。不是调用者的管理员身份。

取值说明：true、false。具体业务含义见对应字段说明

IsWhiteList.description_en: An internal field. We do not recommend that you use this field

Labels.description_en: An internal field. We do not recommend that you use this field

LicenseType.description_en: An internal field. We do not recommend that you use this field

ManageCateEnName.description_en: The English name of the management category of the application
ManageCateEnName.description_zh: 应用管理类目的英文名称

ManageCateId.description_en: The management category ID of the application, which may differ from the display category CateId
ManageCateId.description_zh: 应用管理类目 ID，可能与展示类目 CateId 不同

ManageCateName.description_en: The management category name of the application

OriginAppType.description_en:
The application type.

Valid values:
ClientBase: Client-based application.
WebBase: Web-based application
OriginAppType.description_zh:
应用形态，

取值说明：ClientBase：客户端应用；WebBase：Web 应用

OsType.description_en:
The operating system type of the application.

Valid values:
WINDOWS: Windows.
LINUX: Linux.
ANDROID: Android.
UNKNOWN: Unknown operating system
OsType.description_zh:
应用操作系统类型，

取值说明：WINDOWS：Windows；LINUX：Linux；ANDROID：Android；UNKNOWN：未知操作系统

OwnerOs.title_en: 操作系统 (WINDOWS, LINUX, ANDROID, UNKNOWN)
OwnerOs.title_zh: 操作系统 (WINDOWS, LINUX, ANDROID, UNKNOWN)

PublishDate.description_en: The publish time of the application. The value is returned as a string with a time zone, in the format of date, the letter T, hours-minutes-seconds, 3-digit milliseconds, and a time zone offset without colons. The +0000 in the example indicates UTC. This field may be empty or not returned if no value is available
PublishDate.description_zh: 应用发布时间。以带时区的字符串返回，依次包含日期、字母 T、时分秒、3 位毫秒及不带冒号的时区偏移；示例中的 +0000 表示 UTC。无值时可能为空或不返回

PublishType.description_en:
The customer scope of the application.

Valid values:
ENT: Enterprise.
PER: Individual.
BOTH: Enterprise and individual
PublishType.description_zh:
应用面向的客户范围，

取值说明：ENT：企业；PER：个人；BOTH：企业和个人

SearchTag.description_en: An internal field. We do not recommend that you use this field

SilenceFlag.description_en:
Indicates whether silent installtion is supported. Valid values:
0: Not supported.
1: Supported.

This field indicates the application capability and does not represent the actual installation execute result
SilenceFlag.description_zh: 是否支持静默安装：0 表示不支持，1 表示支持。该字段表示应用能力，不代表实际安装执行结果

SilenceParam.description_en: The silent installtion parameters, used by the corresponding installation flow
SilenceParam.description_zh: 静默安装参数，供相应安装流程使用

Size.description_en: The size of the installation package

SourceType.description_en:
The application source. Valid values:
MARKET: Alibaba Cloud Marketplace application.
TENANT: Tenant-uploaded application.
UNKNOWN: Unknown source
SourceType.description_zh:
应用来源，

取值说明：MARKET：市场应用；TENANT：租户上传应用；UNKNOWN：未知来源

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the application authorization. The value is returned as a string with time zone information, in the format of date, the letter T, hours-minutes-seconds, 3-digit milliseconds, and a time zone offset without colons. The +0000 in the example indicates UTC. This field may be empty or not returned if no value is available
StartTime.description_zh: 应用授权开始时间。以带时区的字符串返回，依次包含日期、字母 T、时分秒、3 位毫秒及不带冒号的时区偏移；示例中的 +0000 表示 UTC。无值时可能为空或不返回

Status.description_en:
The application status. This field does not represent the installation status on the endpoint. Valid values:
NORMAL: Normal.
DELETE: Deleted.
UNCHECK: Not reviewed or not verified.
DISABLE: All versions are unavailable.
UNKNOWN: Unknown status.

The following historical statuses from the sandbox packaging and publishing process are deprecated. Do not use them: UNPACKED (not packaged), TESTING (packaged, pending testing), UNPUBLISHED (testing completed, not published), PUBLISHED (published)
Status.description_zh:
应用状态，此字段不代表终端安装状态。

取值说明：NORMAL：正常；DELETE：已删除；UNCHECK：未审核／未检验；DISABLE：所有版本不可用；UNKNOWN：未知状态。沙箱打包发布流程的历史状态已废弃，请勿使用：UNPACKED（未打包）、TESTING（已打包、待测试）、UNPUBLISHED（测试完成、未发布）、PUBLISHED（已发布）

SubSourceType.description_en:
The secondary source of the application. Valid values:
ALI_MARKET: Alibaba Cloud Marketplace.
ISV: Independent software vendor.
OPS: Operations channel.
UNKNOWN: Unknown source
SubSourceType.description_zh:
应用的二级来源，

取值说明：ALI_MARKET：云市场；ISV：软件服务商；OPS：运营渠道；UNKNOWN：未知来源
SubSourceType.title_en: 二级应用来源 (ALI_MARKET, ISV, OPS, UNKNOWN)
SubSourceType.title_zh: 二级应用来源 (ALI_MARKET, ISV, OPS, UNKNOWN)

SupplierId.description_en: The account ID of the application supplier or uploader
SupplierId.description_zh: 应用供应方或上传方的账号 ID

UserTag.description_en: An internal field. We do not recommend that you use this field

items.description_en: An internal field. We do not recommend that you use this field

VersionName.description_en: The display name of the application version

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code field in the business response. This field may be empty. The actual transmission status is determined by the HTTP response status
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 业务响应中的 HTTP 状态码字段，可能为空；实际传输状态以 HTTP 响应状态为准

Message.description_en: The description of the request processing result

PageNumber.description_en: The actual page number of the query

PageSize.description_en: The actual number of entries per page

RequestId.description_en: The request tracking ID. Provide this value when reporting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求跟踪 ID，反馈调用问题时请提供该值

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. Valid values:
true: Succeeded.
false: Failed.

Refer to the corresponding field descriptions for specific business meanings
Success.description_zh:
请求处理是否成功：true 成功，false 失败。

取值说明：true、false。具体业务含义见对应字段说明

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of applications that match the filter conditions. This value is not equal to the length of the array on the current page
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足筛选条件的应用总数，不等于当前页数组长度
